text:
Alex Laferriere is getting a promotion and waiting for the goals to notice. He's playing 19:30 a night for the Kings, up from 18:19, and he's on the ice for 68% of their power-play time after 30% last season. His own chances are up too, to 1.29 expected goals per 60 (the quality of his shots) from 0.96.

The scoreboard hasn't caught on. He has two goals in 14 games on 5.8 expected, and none in his last eight on 4.3 expected. Shooting 5.4% is far below what we'd expect, so this looks like a drought, not a decline. He still has eight assists, and at 5v5 the Kings are almost eight points better in expected-goal share with him on than without. For a third-round pick who went through Harvard, a bigger role and power-play minutes at 25 is a real step. Our projection has 17 to 31 more goals. If the coaches keep the minutes where they are, the goals should follow the looks.
headline: Laferriere has the role, not yet the goals
